##### Project general facts

Sweden Island is home to an extraordinary collection of ten prestigious beachfront palaces, inspired by the beautifully crafted and intricate structure of inverted Swedish Viking vessels. Across all floors of each majestic residence, including the Viking sky terrace, every detail has been considered to ensure an unforgettable living experience. With just ten palaces, each with their own private white sandy beach and exotic lush gardens, Sweden Island offers the ultimate privacy and relaxation in palatial settings reminiscent of fairytale Maldivian castles with enchanting sea views.

The ambience at Sweden Island is refined and exclusive, with carefully curated events exclusive to residents. Each estate features a grand reception room with a striking wall of windows on the top floor offering mesmerising views of the seascape and the islands. Influenced by Swedish architecture and lifestyle, the palaces are enveloped in private, secluded exotic gardens with unspoiled beach surroundings.

Combining traditional and modernist interior design, every residence at Sweden Island features handcrafted furniture inspired by materials and luxurious finishes synonymous with Bentley car interiors. Each palace includes seven bedrooms, a sauna, a snow room, and a grand reception room, creating a living experience that is both refined and unforgettable. 

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled within The World Islands, a remarkable man-made archipelago located off the coast of Dubai, this exceptional location offers a symbol of opulence and grandeur. The ambitious development comprises a collection of small islands shaped like a world map, each representing a different country or region, designed to offer luxurious and exclusive living experiences.

The location is distinguished by its unparalleled privacy and exclusivity. The islands provide an elite retreat for residents and visitors, offering lavish villas, mansions, and private estates with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and access to pristine beaches. High-end resorts, boutique hotels, and entertainment facilities ensure world-class dining, spa treatments, and water sports are always within reach.

For those seeking a residence that embodies Viking-inspired elegance, island seclusion, and the ultimate in luxury living, The World Islands deliver an unmatched lifestyle. Their unique combination of man-made grandeur, natural beauty, and a prestigious Dubai address makes them one of the most desirable destinations in the world. This is a place where one can escape to a private paradise — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected to the city that has it all.
